title: Ōi River Trip
description: Nadeshiko, Rin, and Ayano go on a trip to the northern region of Hamamatsu along the Ōi River. This is also Ayano’s first trip. She and Rin go touring on motorcycles, while Nadeshiko takes the train. Along the way, they visit many suspension bridges.

title: Mizugakiyama Natural Park Trip
description: The trio of Ena, Aki, and Aoi return for their own journey. This time, they visit Mizugakiyama Natural Park, located in Hokuto, Yamanashi Prefecture.

title: Cherry Blossom Viewing Trip
description: A trip that closes Season 3. All the characters go on their own journeys. Rin does a solo trip around Yamanashi, Aki starts her own solo trip, and others go on their separate ways too. After that, they all gather and go camping in Nanbu, near Nadeshiko’s house.

title: Season 3 Extra
description: A list of places featured in Episode 1 (Rin’s flashback) and Episode 2 (Ayano’s solo trip). This also includes a few miscellaneous locations.
